svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: The router changes only the destination to the mesh address of VM V and keeps the client source. From here it is the gateway inbound path: the VM hook tunnels it to host 1, and the WireGuard hook checks the return route before it delivers.
